Nor did He turn your wives whom you estrange (according to your custom) into your mothers.* Nor did He turn your adopted children into genetic offspring. All these are mere utterances that you have invented. GOD speaks the truth, and He guides in the (right) path. Do Not Change Your Names

verse_text_english: You shall give your adopted children names that preserve their relation­ ship to their genetic fathers. This is more equitable in the sight of GOD. If you do not know their fathers, then, as your brethren in religion, you shall treat them as members of your family. You do not commit a sin if you make a mistake in this respect; you are only responsible for your actual intentions. GOD is Forgiver, Most Merciful.

verse_text_english: O you who believe, remember GOD’s attacked you; we sent upon them violent wind, and invisible soldiers. GOD is Seer of everything you do.
verse_text_arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ جَآءَتْكُمْ جُنُودٌ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا وَجُنُودًا لَّمْ تَرَوْهَا وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا

verse_text_english: They came from above you, and from beneath you. Your eyes and hearts were terrified, and you harbored unbefitting thoughts about GOD.
verse_text_arabic: إِذْ جَآءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ وَإِذْ زَاغَتِ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ وَبَلَغَتِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ ٱلْحَنَاجِرَ وَتَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلظُّنُونَا۠
verse_text_transliterated: idh jāūkum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa-idh zāghati l-abṣāru wabalaghati l-qulūbu l-ḥanājira wataẓunnūna bil-lahi l-ẓunūn
verse_text_arabic_clean: إذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن أسفل منكم وإذ زاغت الأبصر وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا

verse_text_english: That is when the believers were truly tested, and were severely shaken up.
verse_text_arabic: هُنَالِكَ ٱبْتُلِىَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَزُلْزِلُوا۟ زِلْزَالًا شَدِيدًا

verse_text_english: The hypocrites and those with doubts in their hearts said, “What GOD and His messenger promised us was no more than an illusion!”
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ مَّا وَعَدَنَا ٱللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُۥٓ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idh yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wa-alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun mā waʿadanā l-lahu warasūluhu illā ghurūra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذ يقول المنفقون والذين فى قلوبهم مرض ما وعدنا الله ورسوله إلا غرورا

verse_text_english: A group of them said, “O people of Yathrib, you cannot attain victory; go back.” Others made up excuses to the prophet: “Our homes are exposed,” when they were not exposed. They just wanted to flee.
verse_text_arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْهُمْ يَٰٓأَهْلَ يَثْرِبَ لَا مُقَامَ لَكُمْ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَيَسْتَـْٔذِنُ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلنَّبِىَّ يَقُولُونَ إِنَّ بُيُوتَنَا عَوْرَةٌ وَمَا هِىَ بِعَوْرَةٍ إِن يُرِيدُونَ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verse_text_transliterated: wa-idh qālat ṭāifatun min'hum yāahla yathriba lā muqāma lakum fa-ir'jiʿū wayastadhinu farīqun min'humu l-nabiya yaqūlūna inna buyūtanā ʿawratun wamā hiya biʿawratin in yurīdūna illā firāra
verse_text_arabic_clean: وإذ قالت طائفة منهم يأهل يثرب لا مقام لكم فارجعوا ويستـٔذن فريق منهم النبى يقولون إن بيوتنا عورة وما هى بعورة إن يريدون إلا فرارا

verse_text_english: Had the enemy invaded, and asked them to join, they would have joined the enemy without hesitation.
verse_text_arabic: وَلَوْ دُخِلَتْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنْ أَقْطَارِهَا ثُمَّ سُئِلُوا۟ ٱلْفِتْنَةَ لَءَاتَوْهَا وَمَا تَلَبَّثُوا۟ بِهَآ إِلَّا يَسِيرًا

verse_text_arabic_clean: ولو دخلت عليهم من أقطارها ثم سئلوا الفتنة لءاتوها وما تلبثوا بها إلا يسيرا

verse_text_english: They had covenanted with GOD in th and flee; making a pledge with GOD
verse_text_arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ عَٰهَدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مِن قَبْلُ لَا يُوَلُّونَ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ وَكَانَ عَهْدُ ٱللَّهِ مَسْـُٔولًا

verse_text_english: Say, “If you flee, you can never flee fro No matter what happens, you only live
verse_text_arabic: قُل لَّن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْفِرَارُ إِن فَرَرْتُم مِّنَ ٱلْمَوْتِ أَوِ ٱلْقَتْلِ وَإِذًا لَّا تُمَتَّعُونَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

verse_text_english: Say, “Who would protect you from GO or willed any blessing for you?” They c any other Lord or Master.
verse_text_arabic: قُلْ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَعْصِمُكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ سُوٓءًا أَوْ أَرَادَ بِكُمْ رَحْمَةً وَلَا يَجِدُونَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيًّا وَلَا نَصِيرًا

verse_text_english: GOD is fully aware of the hinderers a and those who say to their comrades, “Let us all stay behind.” Rarely do they mobilize for defense.
verse_text_arabic: قَدْ يَعْلَمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُعَوِّقِينَ مِنكُمْ وَٱلْقَآئِلِينَ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ هَلُمَّ إِلَيْنَا وَلَا يَأْتُونَ ٱلْبَأْسَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا

verse_text_english: They are too stingy when dealing with you. If anything threatens the com­ munity, you see their eyes rolling with fear, as if death had already come to them. verse_text_english: O you who believe, do not enter the prophet’s homes unless you are given permission to eat, nor shall you force such an invitation. Once you are invited, you may enter. When you finish eating, you shall leave; do not engage him in lengthy conversations. This used to hurt the prophet, and he was too shy to tell you. But GOD does not shy away from the truth.
